_comment: ULTRON Cockpit scheduler configuration. Edit this file then run: ultron schedule install. Tasks fire AT LAPTOP WAKE (unlock/resume) with delays — no fixed 8AM times. Each script checks via marker if it already ran today/this-week to avoid duplicate runs. v11: register_wake_triggers.ps1 adds SessionStateChange+EventTrigger to all daily tasks.

ScanProjects-Login.description: Re-scan filesystem for projects every login [DISABLED — manual edits only]

Retention-Daily.description: Rotate logs (routing 30d, news 30d, backups 90d). Skip if already ran today.

Standup-Weekday.description: Generate AI standup with last 24h activity + git commits + recommendation. Skip weekends and if already ran today.

TUI-Login.description: Open TUI in Windows Terminal at login. DISABLED by default - enable if you want auto-launch.

Research-Weekly.description: Deep research via Gemini Pro CLI (~5-10K tokens). Skip if already ran this week.

GithubTrending-Daily.description: Scrape GitHub Trending (daily) for AI/ML + USER's tech stack. Filter by score, write digest to ~/.ultron/cockpit/trending/. Skip if already ran today.

Doctor-Weekly.description: Run doctor.py --health-check to detect environment drift (16 detectors). Skip if already ran this week.

Backup-Weekly.description: v14.7 BACKUP-WATCH: weekly robocopy of CARRERA/PERSONAL/.ultron/.ultron-vault/.claude to D:\USER\BACKUP. Skip if D: drive missing or already ran this week.

_how_to_edit: 1. Set task.enabled = false to disable a specific task
2. Adjust delay_minutes to control execution order at login (avoid simultaneous spike)
5. Run: ultron schedule install (regenerates Windows Task Scheduler from this config)
